## Change

What user-visible behavior or concrete deliverable changes? Link the task/backlog ID.

## Ownership

Owner, branch/worktree, owned paths and any shared-file exception. Name dependent PRs if needed.

## Validation

- Tier: V0 / V1 / V2
- Actually run: targeted check and result, or diff review only
- Deferred to integration: build/runtime checks, or none
- Evidence: link existing report/handoff; do not paste logs

## Remaining work

Integration dependency or known limitation. Distinguish implementation ready from runtime verified. The user merges PRs.
